title: source_observation_audit_rejects_wrong_receipts_without_releasing_the_provider ran over 60 s once
acceptance: The cause of the test's >60 s run is diagnosed with discriminating evidence (what it waits on, and whether the wait is bounded by a fixture signal or by load), and either the test's waits are made signal-driven or the cause is recorded as environmental with that evidence; no timeout is inflated and no retry added
